Moroxetine is cleared almost entirely by the enzyme HTX-3F, so the most plausible pharmacokinetic interaction would be Caddacaine inhibiting or inducing HTX-3F, altering moroxetine exposure. A second theoretical mechanism is displacement, since moroxetine is 92% plasma-protein bound. However, no pharmacokinetic information about Caddacaine is provided at all — nothing on its effect on HTX-3F, protein-binding displacement, or absorption. Without knowing whether Caddacaine modulates HTX-3F, I cannot establish a mechanism-based interaction, but I also cannot rule one out. The available data are therefore insufficient to confirm a clinically significant interaction; the "NO" below reflects absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
